Class ListEntries

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.runner.tools.ListEntries
public final class ListEntries extends Object
The list mode: prints every logical name the archive resolves, and where each one comes from.

Selected with -Dmicronaut.runner.mode=list, optionally with one argument that keeps only the names starting with it. The point of the mode is to answer "why does this resource resolve to that copy": the records are printed in class path order, every line names the jar it belongs to, and the lines that do not win a lookup say which record wins instead. A multi-release alias prints the version that put it in front of its base entry, and a directory that no archive actually contains is marked as synthesised, so that a lookup that succeeds for a directory nobody packaged is not a surprise.

The winner is computed for the runtime this JVM reports, so running the mode under a different jdk.util.jar.version prints the resolution that would happen there.

This class is loaded only when the mode selects it, so it is written in ordinary Java: the rules that keep io.micronaut.runner free of lambdas, streams and String.format do not apply to io.micronaut.runner.tools.
